svg.title: Phone: throughput by protocol — higher is better
svg.desc: Small multiples of throughput, MiB/s per protocol for download and upload with 1 and 4 flows on a OnePlus 15. Values are in data/protocols-throughput.csv.
svg.text: Phone: throughput by protocol — higher is better
OnePlus 15 (SM8850), Android 17 · 2026-11-01 · loopback, CPU-bound · Go Xray v26.10.21 server on the phone · xray-rust profile
Mobile, TUN MTU 1500 · median of 5 runs with min–max
Label: median and change vs VLESS raw. VLESS + Mux (concurrency 8) download failed the payload check in 10/10 runs: the Mux
session aborts when the 8-frame child queue overflows (mux.rs).

svg.text: Source: data/main; devicehost VpnService (fd backend): adb-shell nc → tun0 → xray-rust → 127.0.0.1 Go Xray → loopback sink; fresh
process per config, round-robin. Host CPU = utime+stime of the devicehost process; Go server CPU excluded.
